title: Sour Pickle Cartoon Intro
look_clause: semi-realistic 3D caricature characters with exaggerated cartoon proportions, rendered with photoreal skin, real fabric and physically accurate light so they sit inside live-action photography, cinematic 35mm, shallow depth of field
grade: warm highlights, green-leaning midtones, lifted blacks, saturated and cheerful, Saturday-morning cartoon colour
negative: flat 2d, cel shading, line art, anime, plastic toy, uncanny dead eyes, deformed hands, extra fingers, garbled text, watermark
logline: A car screeches to a halt outside The Sour Pickle Cafe and two caricatures let themselves in.

THE_OWNER.name: The Owner
THE_OWNER.clause: a short, slightly built woman, in their fifties, fair skin, a round face, dark eyes, almond eyes, brown short neat hair, a single small earring, an open, warm bearing, a caricature of the real owner of The Sour Pickle Cafe: a cheerful middle-aged East Asian woman with a large caricatured head and a small body, short dark brown hair with a soft fringe swept back off the face, fine rimless wire-frame glasses, one small gold hoop earring, a wide open delighted grin showing her teeth, laugh lines around the eyes, wearing a bright magenta-pink short-sleeved t-shirt under a deep burgundy-red bib apron with a small gold embroidered emblem on the chest and a front pocket, warm and welcoming, always mid-gesture
THE_OWNER.short: brown short neat hair, a single small earring

THE_PICKLE.name: The Pickle
THE_PICKLE.clause: a short, full-figured walking cartoon mascot character with arms and legs, an easy, confident grin, a walking cartoon gherkin mascot brought to life from a hand-painted pub sign: a bright green pickle for a body, chest-high to an adult, covered in the small bumps and warts of a real pickling cucumber, a huge open grinning mouth with a red tongue, two big round googly cartoon eyes with pale yellow whites and black pupils, thin rubbery green arms and legs straight out of the body with no shoulders or hips, oversized cream-yellow four-fingered cartoon gloves and matching cream-yellow shoes, no clothing, permanently mid-dance with one arm thrown up, gleeful and mischievous, no human features and no face beyond the eyes and mouth
THE_PICKLE.short: a walking cartoon mascot character with arms and legs

ANNOUNCER.name: Announcer
ANNOUNCER.voice_desc: a big excited cartoon announcer voice
